title: Adversarial verification и resource envelopes
goal:
P8 превращает гарантии P2–P7 в failure-oriented доказательства: один versioned
risk/proof manifest связывает каждую security/durability boundary с независимым oracle,
детерминированным corpus, обязательным fault model и воспроизводимым receipt. Фаза ищет
ложно-зелёные проверки, а не добавляет ещё один happy-path regression layer. `RAG:—`.

PHP получает scoped Infection campaign и набор обязательных semantic mutants. Dart получает
тот же language-neutral fault catalog через digest-bound patches в disposable tree; regex-based
generic mutation score не выдаётся за эквивалент AST mutation. Property/fuzz cases и storage
schedules имеют стабильные seeds, generator/schedule versions и promoted minimized regressions.
PostgreSQL проверяется реальными процессами и соединениями, без SQLite substitution и sleep-based
ordering. Resource gates отделяют portable deterministic limits от осторожно сравнимого только на
том же fingerprint timing evidence. `RAG:✅` в `@plan/knowledge/research-P8-design-rag.json`.

> **Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: terminal guarantees/contracts/receipts P1–P7.
> Производит: adversarial-verification contract, risk/proof manifest, deterministic corpus,
> mutation and PostgreSQL schedule evidence, calibrated resource baselines и aggregate P8 receipt.
> Границы: тест не переписывает upstream semantics; P9 владеет CI/workflow wiring, P10 — RC acceptance.

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: security-external
> Integration Seams: php-infection · dart-semantic-mutants · cross-language-corpus · parser-jcs-token · postgres-workers · replay-lease-eventstore · resource-fingerprint
> Live or Irreversible: no
> Audit Intent: direct-close-eligible
> Rationale: named critical mutants, independent byte/error oracles, explicit PostgreSQL barriers and digest-bound receipts make false-green claims observable; Review=full.

# Закрытие фазы P8

> Не править руками: это генерируемый вид.

## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: terminal guarantees/contracts/receipts P1–P7.
Производит: adversarial-verification contract, risk/proof manifest, deterministic corpus,
mutation and PostgreSQL schedule evidence, calibrated resource baselines и aggregate P8 receipt.
Границы: тест не переписывает upstream semantics; P9 владеет CI/workflow wiring, P10 — RC acceptance.

## Произведено

- P8.1 — Заморозить adversarial verification contract и risk/proof manifest: Adversarial verification policy, exact risk/proof manifest, deterministic validator and complete P1–P7 proof-coverage report.
- P8.2 — Построить deterministic property, differential и bounded fuzz corpus: Reproducible cross-language property/fuzz harness, versioned corpus and promoted regressions, minimized failure protocol and digest-bound parity receipt.
- P8.3 — Убить critical PHP/Dart mutants и закрепить calibrated mutation gates: Locked PHP Infection configuration and baseline, cross-language critical mutant catalog/runner, zero-critical-survivor receipt and explicit equivalent/exclusion review.
- P8.4 — Доказать PostgreSQL invariants multi-process crash schedules: Deterministic PostgreSQL schedule corpus, safe multi-process controller/workers, crash/concurrency traces and digest-bound replay/lease/event invariant receipt.
- P8.5 — Калибровать resource envelopes и выпустить aggregate P8 receipt: Calibrated portable resource gates, host-bound benchmark baseline with raw evidence, explicit flake/quarantine policy and aggregate P8 adversarial receipt ready for P9 automation and P10 acceptance.

## Known Deviations

- P8.2: Deterministic corpus+differential GREEN; CRP-JCS-10K/CRP-SEM-213 declared not proved.
- P8.3: 26/26 catalog kills; Infection 0.35.4 combined MSI 75.68 floor 70; enum file excluded.

## Решения

- [D13](../../decisions/D13-adversarial-verification-evidence.md)

sections.title: DoR (Definition of Ready)
sections.text:
- [x] F10 и P1–P7 residual ownership сведены в `@plan/knowledge/research-P8-design.json`.
- [x] Mutation/property/PostgreSQL/benchmark premises проверены через Perplexity и primary sources.
- [x] D13 фиксирует asymmetric mutation tooling, deterministic evidence и benchmark boundary.
- [x] Нет универсального coverage/MSI/latency процента, не выведенного из risk/baseline evidence.
- [ ] P1.4/P1.5, P2.4, P3.4, P4.4, P5.4, P6.5 и P7.4 закрыты GREEN и доступны по digest.
- [ ] Execution preflight доказывает isolated PostgreSQL target и безопасный cleanup.

sections.title: Scope Included
sections.text:
Versioned risk-to-proof matrix; deterministic language-neutral generators and shrinkers; raw-invalid,
metamorphic and cross-language differential corpora; PHP Infection campaign; curated critical
semantic mutants for both SDKs; real PostgreSQL multi-process schedules with observable barriers,
client/backend crash modes and clock-skew cases; parser/page/contention/resource envelopes;
environment fingerprints, raw benchmark samples, flake/quarantine rules and aggregate receipts.

sections.title: Scope Excluded
sections.text:
New product semantics or guarantee wording; automatic weakening of an upstream contract after RED;
SQLite/in-memory evidence as proof of PostgreSQL arbitration; indefinite fuzzing service; formal
verification; one global coverage/MSI/latency number; comparing PHP and Dart speed; CI workflows,
runner fleet or schedule ownership; public release/tag/upload; server/power-loss WAL certification.

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.text:
P8.1 waits for terminal P1.4/P1.5, P2.4, P3.4, P4.4, P5.4, P6.5 and P7.4 evidence.
P8.2 and P8.4 wait for P8.1 and may proceed independently. P8.3 waits for P8.2 so the ordinary
property/differential suite can kill its fault catalog. P8.5 waits for P8.2–P8.4. A P8 failure
against upstream semantics is returned to the exact owning item through the plan repair/readiness
protocol; P8 never makes the test green by silently changing the contract. D2 still forbids product
execution until all phase designs and the whole-plan design audit are GREEN.
